ACTUAL EVIDENCE
User reports camera confirmation prompt appeared, followed by a screenshot of
'富士属性长度无效'. In production that message is raised only by property()
after command ACK identity, OpenSession and event polling have succeeded.
This is property-negotiation progress; it is NOT full gallery/download success.
The old message does not expose the exact property or payload width, so the
user's exact response has not been captured and is not represented as known.

CONFIRMED GAP AND FIX
The old scalar helper accepted2/4 bytes but omitted1 byte. libpict's actual
ptp_parse_prop_value supports UINT8/UINT16/UINT32 (1/2/4 bytes).
New code supports bounded unsigned1-byte scalar values. Zero/3/oversize lengths
remain failures; errors identify property0xNNNN and observed length when read.
Malformed framed/oversize data is still rejected by existing transport limits.
PTP refusal exception types are preserved for the optional-property branch.

Channel connect errors now identify the actual command/event/preview port.
Auxiliary-port refusal says command handshake completed, instead of having
AlbumController label all refusals as the configured command port55740.
Each failure still closes every previously opened channel.

TESTS RUN THIS ROUND
1. Changed the synthetic camera from all-uint32 responses to mixed widths:
   DF21 is2 bytes; optional D244 is1 byte(value255); version fields are4 bytes.
2. Ran the fixture against old production code: FAILED with the same generic
   '富士属性长度无效' at property()/optionalProperty(), reproducing the omission.
3. Applied the production fix and reran tests/run-fuji.ps1: PASS.
   Covers complete mixed-width setup and byte-preserved chunk download,
   invalid0/3/5-byte DF21 responses (correct property detail and close),
   refused55740/55741/55742 (actual channel/port and close), identity mismatch,
   transaction mismatch, oversized packet, short chunk, forbidden delete,
   cancellation before setup and independent cancellation during download.
4. APK compile/sign/badging/hash/attribution checks: PASS.
5. git diff --check: PASS (normal repository LF/CRLF notices only).

LIMITS
No true-camera packet capture, completed gallery connection, real JPEG download,
native Android UI or background/lockscreen test this round. Mixed-width fixtures
prove the parser omission and its correction; they do not prove the user's
exact failing property was D244 or1 byte. If another property layout fails,
the next message now contains its code and length rather than a generic error.
No unchanged gateway/full-album suites claimed rerun; their prior evidence
remains in the0.12.1 validation record. Existing unrelated USB fixture limitation
remains in the0.12.0 record.

RETRY
Install0.12.2 over the existing app, re-enter X-T20 Wireless Communication,
connect with automatic address selection, and press OK on the camera when
the phone/connection confirmation appears. Do not change the IP to the phone's
own WLAN IPv4 address. Physical X-T20 completion still needs confirmation.
